evidence_required: Verdict with the mechanism (idle power management) and the condition that would indicate a defect.

marking.criterion: Mechanism: link speed down-trains at idle to save power and returns to Gen 5 under load
Defect condition: below Gen 5 under load, or width below x16 (width does not change with load; x8 halves bandwidth to ≈ 31.5 GB/s per direction)

title: PCIe Gen 1 at idle: defect or power management?
